other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala
Candidate must be a retired scientist/academician from Kerala (by birth or domicile)
Application must be made within 5 years of superannuation
Must have published at least 3 peer‑reviewed papers in SCI‑indexed journals with impact factor greater than 2.0, or filed at least one patent in the last 3 years
Applicants who have previously received an Emeritus Scientist Fellowship (from KSCSTE or elsewhere) are ineligible
The research centre for the proposed work must be one of the R&D Centres of KSCSTE
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹31,000 for up to three years, an annual contingent grant of ₹1,00,000 and technical assistance through a project fellow.
